title: sae config
description: Configuration for the sae JSON-RPC load balancer. default.config.json must be complete; a user config.json may override any subset.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor tooling.

port.description: TCP port to listen on. Overridden by the PORT env var and --port flag.

healthCheckIntervalMs.description: Interval between upstream health-check rounds, in milliseconds.

maxLagBlocks.description: Default for all chains: upstreams more than this many blocks behind the best-known head are deprioritized (not removed). A chain may override it.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the circuit opens.

cooldownMs.description: How long the circuit stays open before allowing a half-open probe, in milliseconds.

halfOpenMaxProbes.description: Concurrent probe requests allowed while half-open.

chains.description: Chains to serve. In a user config.json this replaces the default list wholesale.

slug.description: URL path segment, e.g. "eth" -> POST /eth and wss://.../eth. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.

family.description: JSON-RPC dialect. Decides the health-probe method (eth_blockNumber vs getSlot) and how its result is read. Defaults to "evm".

chainId.description: EVM chain ID. Required for family "evm"; omit for families with no numeric chain ID.

upstreams.description: HTTP(S) RPC endpoints, tried in health/latency order.

wsUpstreams.description: Optional WebSocket RPC endpoints. Omit to disable WS for this chain.

maxAttempts.description: Max upstreams tried per incoming request.

maxLagBlocks.description: Overrides the top-level maxLagBlocks for this chain. Useful where block time differs sharply from the default (e.g. ~400ms Solana slots).
